description.zh: 按关键词采集抖音「直播」标签下的直播间：进房、走分享流程取短链、解析稳定的 room_id 与主播抖音号（author_id），落盘到 records.jsonl 后批量上报。再次采到同一个直播间时，用这次观测到的本场点赞/在线观众就地更新那一行，缺抖音号的老记录会补上；页面没显示的计数保持原值。支持分片与断点续跑，附带一个连续采集与上报的工作流模板。
description.en: Collect Douyin live rooms from the Live tab for a keyword: enter each room, take its share link, resolve the stable room_id and the host's Douyin ID (author_id), append it to records.jsonl and upload it to your server. Re-collecting a room updates that row's live like and viewer counts when they are observed and fills author_id on older rows that lack it, with counts the page did not show kept as-is. Supports chunked resumable runs and ships a continuous collect-and-upload workflow template.

display_name.zh: 连续采集抖音直播并上报
display_name.en: Continuous Douyin Live Collect and Upload

description.zh: 一轮采一片直播间的分享链接并上报，整轮结束后随机等 30–120 秒接着跑下一轮。导入后可以改关键词、直播间数与间隔。
description.en: Each round collects one chunk of live-room share links and uploads it, then waits a random 30–120 seconds before the next round. Edit the keyword, room count and gap after importing.
